Leadership • Vision • Governance

Luxury homes and commercial property in KwaZulu-Natal, handled personally

Rohan Ramlall represents sellers, landlords, buyers and tenants for Blue Ocean Realty, from Durban North.

Who is Rohan Ramlall?

Rohan grew up in Queensburgh and has lived in KwaZulu-Natal his whole life. He joined Blue Ocean Realty (Pty) Ltd in 2026 as a Candidate Property Practitioner. Most of his deals so far have been commercial and industrial leases, alongside the estate homes on this site.

He also runs Apex Digital SA, which builds websites, automations and social media marketing for South African businesses. That is why every property here gets its own detailed page, its own short film on Instagram, TikTok and Facebook, and enquiries answered the moment they arrive.

“I enjoy working with these properties and meeting the people behind them, hearing how they got there. The best part is connecting people with what is possible right here in Durban.”
Rohan Ramlall

Selling or letting a property in KZN?

This site only carries luxury estate homes, offices, retail and industrial space, so the people who find your property here are already looking for one like it. Sole and open mandates are both welcome.

  • A full listing page with every fact a buyer or tenant asks for, built to show up in Google and in AI search answers.
  • A short property film shot and promoted on Instagram, TikTok and Facebook.
  • Immediate replies to every enquiry, and viewings booked around your schedule and the buyer’s.
  • Regular updates on who has viewed, what they said, and any offers.
Talk to Rohan on WhatsApp Or send your property details

Buying or renting?

Every listing here fits a luxury, commercial or industrial brief, so you are not sorting through hundreds of results. Buyers moving from Johannesburg, Cape Town or overseas are welcome, and viewings can be arranged around your travel dates.

See homes for sale See commercial space to let

How does a viewing work?

  1. Send a WhatsApp, call 069 522 4226 or use the form on any listing. Rohan replies straight away.
  2. You agree a time that suits you and the owner.
  3. Rohan meets you at the property and answers your questions on site.
  4. If you want to go ahead, he takes you through the offer to purchase or lease, and the next steps with the attorneys.

Who is Blue Ocean Realty?

Blue Ocean Realty (Pty) Ltd is a property firm registered with the Property Practitioners Regulatory Authority, based at Suite 6, 66 Adelaide Tambo Drive, Durban North. Its main website, blueoceanrealty.co.za, lists the agency’s full range of property. This site is its specialist showcase for luxury estates and for commercial and industrial property across KwaZulu-Natal.

Registration and supervision details are on the statutory disclosure page.
